source:
@@U03892@@
If in peace you long for war, you've left behind all hope of happiness.

@@U03894@@
You, oh you whom this land brought forth, leading you from danger to danger, men, free, boundless in courage, careless of the lives it cost you— lead, lead on with unquenchable spirit, an inspiration to all fighters.

@@U03896@@
Look! Look up there! How high he’s climbed! And seems no smaller to us! Armor-clad and keen for conquest, in bronze and steel he gleams like the sun!

@@U03898@@
No ramparts now, no walls to guard you, every man must know himself! A mighty fortress is man’s stout heart! Is freedom your goal? Then charge light-armed onto the field! Let women be amazons, and every child a hero!

@@U03900@@
Sacred poetry, rise, oh, rise to the highest heaven, shine from on high though ever receding, the fairest of stars that reaches us always, no matter how far, eternal delight!

@@U03902@@
Born a child, a child no longer,
translation:
@@U03892@@
如果在和平时期你渴望战争，那么你就放弃了所有幸福的希望。

@@U03894@@
你们，噢，这片土地所孕育的你们，带领你们从一个危险走向另一个危险，自由的人，无限的勇气，毫不关心为此付出的生命——领导，以不灭的精神领导，激励所有战士。

@@U03896@@
看！抬头看那里！他爬得多高啊！对我们来说似乎并不小！他身披铠甲，热衷于征服，青铜和钢铁的他像太阳一样闪闪发光！

@@U03898@@
现在没有壁垒，没有围墙来保护你，每个人都必须认识自己！坚强的心就是坚固的堡垒！自由是你的目标吗？然后轻装上阵！让女人成为亚马逊，让每个孩子成为英雄！

@@U03900@@
神圣的诗歌，升起，哦，升到最高的天堂，从高处闪耀，尽管不断远去，最美丽的星星总是到达我们身边，无论多远，永恒的喜悦！

@@U03902@@
生了孩子，不再是孩子，
